_comment: Single source of every tunable value for tools/tiles (P1-F02-T06). Scripts read this file with jq; nothing here is duplicated in code. See README.md.

area.name: bangkok-and-vicinity
area._regionModeComment: bbox = rectangle area.bbox (default, matches D-031 numbers). provinces = pmtiles --region from the district polygons of the playable provinces (fewer tiles, blank outside provinces; see size report).

budget._comment: Cloudflare Pages Free limits checked 2026-09-23 (tech note 7.1, 7.4). Hard caps fail the build; targets fail the build unless --allow-over-target.
budget._reservedComment: _headers and 404.html added by the devops publish step (P1-F02-T08, tech note 7.5 and 9); counted against the deploy budget here.

basemapsAssets._comment: codeload tarballs are not guaranteed byte-stable, so integrity is checked with treeSha256 over the extracted files we use (sorted sha256 list of relative paths).

notoSansThai._comment: Unhinted static TTF: MapLibre rasterises font-faces to SDF via canvas, so hinting adds bytes without benefit.

fixture.name: lumpini
fixture._comment: Lumphini Park incl. Rama IV (south) and Ratchadamri (west) edges; 18 tiles z0-15. Source maxzoom is 15; clients overzoom to 16+. maxTotalBytes applies to the fixture PMTiles (tech note 9: <= 2 MB).
fixture._limitsComment: maxTotalBytes: fixture PMTiles (tech note 9, <= 2 MB). maxXyzBytes: XYZ tiles. maxDirBytes: whole fixtures/lumpini tree. Every file must also stay under budget.ciMaxCommittedFileBytes (CI guard, P1-F02-T07).

localServe._comment: bin/serve.py serves this directory: out/publish -> /out/publish, fixtures -> /fixtures

estimates._comment: Only used by bin/estimate-area.sh (network dry-run, no download of tiles).
